title: DependencyConstraintEvaluationV1
description: The data of `archctx constraints check`: a read-only evaluation of the model's dependency constraints against observed import edges. `warnings` is added by the constraints-check command from the declaration reader, so it is not part of the evaluator's own type. Without code facts that attest to the measured tree, the evaluation still answers, but `coverage` is not `complete` and the import observations are dropped rather than reported as facts about some other tree.

coverage.description: `complete` only when an index attested to the evaluated worktree and was not truncated.

reasonCodes.description: Why a result is not a complete observation, sorted.

constraintIds.description: The constraints this evaluation covered, in declaration order.

importEdgeCount.description: Import observations the evaluation read; zero when the index did not attest to this tree.

unresolvedImports.description: Repository-local specifiers from constrained files that resolved to no file.

violations.description: One record per (constraint, from path, to path), sorted by those keys.

layerEdges.description: Resolved imports between two layers of one `layer-direction` constraint. An import counts only when every owner of each endpoint carries one shared layer listed in the rule. Present only with a `layer-direction` constraint, `status` `pass` or `violated`, and `coverage` `complete`; otherwise absent. When present it may be an empty list, and it is sorted by `(constraintId, fromLayer, toLayer)`.

imports.description: Import edges, so two specifiers from one file to the same target count twice.

warnings.description: Declaration-reader warnings, such as an unsupported rule. Every unevaluated constraint type produces one, because a validated constraint is not proof that its rule was evaluated.

allOf.description: The layer edges are an observation, so they exist only for a settled verdict over complete coverage.
